subject: Urgent: Renewal review & bakeoff request
messages:
From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@clearside.health>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal window — need a quick bakeoff and pricing clarity

Hi Karthik,

Quick context: our contract with Redwood is up for renewal 2027-01-15. Over the last quarter we’ve had aggressive offers from a competitor promising 20–30% lower unit costs and a 30% throughput uplift on their new infra. Before we engage procurement I wanted to check whether Redwood can run a short benchmark/bakeoff with our production workload so we can make a like-for-like comparison.

What we need from Redwood:
- P95 latency for chat workload and inference throughput at 50k qps-equivalent for 48-hour run
- Token cost estimate normalized to 1M tokens with current optimizations
- Any capacity uplift options (dedicated pools, burst) and lead times

We’re willing to provide a small sampling of production traces and a contract addendum for limited test access (logs masked). If you can respond with a proposed plan + timeline by Monday that’d be great — procurement is pressing for options.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | ClearSide Health
ava.patel@clearside.health

Attachment: clearside_benchmark_inputs.csv (CSV template for samples; see required columns)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@clearside.health>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@clearside.health>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — need a quick bakeoff and pricing clarity

Hi Ava — appreciate the heads up and the CSV. We can run a targeted bakeoff and provide the P95/throughput numbers you requested. Proposed plan below:

Plan (timeline):
- Mon–Tue (Dec 7–8): intake call + get sample traces (use your CSV).
- Wed–Thu (Dec 9–10): Redwood runs 48-hour benchmark (our infra instrumented to mirror your traffic distribution).
- Fri (Dec 11): Deliver readout (P95, throughput, token-cost normalized) and a short ops runbook.

Offer: to simplify procurement conversations we’ll include a short-term, conditional offer: a 3-month price-protection window if you commit to a Dedicated uplift (30% additional reserved capacity) before Jan 15. I’ll get legal to draft a narrow addendum (no long-term lock).

To proceed we need:
1) Sample traces + anonymized payloads (your CSV)
2) A preferred test window and contact for agent access
3) Any SLA targets you require for the evaluation

I’m looping in Soojin (CSM) and Laura (AM) to coordinate scheduling and Marissa for escalation/enablement. I’ll attach the intake template (clearside_benchmark_inputs.csv).

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: clearside_benchmark_inputs.csv

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-07T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Renewal window — need a quick bakeoff and pricing clarity (internal plan)

Team — forwarding Ava’s request and Karthik’s plan. Quick internal note and recommended save package before we respond formally: 

1) Bench harness: SE to re-create their 75th/95th token distribution and priority endpoints (chat vs. batch). Target P95 collection and token cost run. Owner: Laura (SE coordinating with Ops).
2) Commercial save: offer a 3-month price-protection + one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of first-month bill, contingent on 30% Dedicated uplift commit. Document in redwood_save_offer_v3.pdf (attached).
3) SLA concession: offer a one-time 72-hour escalation SLA for throughput regressions during migration window and a dedicated engineer for the bakeoff week.
4) Exec escalation: if we don’t have a signed uplift by 2027-01-05, escalate to Sales Leadership (Marissa will run).

Action items (this week):
- Karthik: confirm legal can do a narrow addendum for price-protection.
- Laura: prepare benchmark harness + quick ops checklist (deadline: Tue Dec 9 EOD).
- Marissa: prepare playbook for executive outreach and approval process.

I’ve attached the proposed commercial summary (redwood_save_offer_v3.pdf) — call out feedback now, we’ll tighten before sending to ClearSide.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_save_offer_v3.pdf

From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@clearside.health>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ava Patel <ava.patel@clearside.health>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — need a quick bakeoff and pricing clarity

Thanks Karthik — this looks reasonable, appreciate the speed. We can provide the CSV sample and a masked trace set. A couple of asks from our side before the run: 
- Can Redwood sign a short evaluation NDA that permits collection of anonymized logs for the benchmark?
- Preferred test window: Dec 9–10 (we can provide night windows 02:00–06:00 PST to avoid production noise).

Also please include a clear comparison table vs. the competing vendor on: P95 latency, token cost, and lead time for Dedicated provisioning. Procurement will want that in writing.

Ava — looped you for approval to share traces.

Best,
Tom Bennett
Director of Infrastructure | ClearSide Health
Tom.Bennett@clearside.health

Date: 2026-12-18T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: Post-bakeoff next steps & owners (internal)

Team — quick wrap after the readout and Tom/Ava’s sign-off on the test window. Summary and actions: 

Summary:
- Benchmark scheduled for Dec 9–10 (night window). ClearSide will provide masked traces and the CSV.
- We’ve committed to deliver a comparison table vs. competitor and a readout by Dec 11.
- Commercial save offer: 3-month price-protection + onboarding credit + 30% Dedicated uplift option if they sign by Jan 15.

Owners / Next steps:
- Laura: run the harness and collect the P95/throughput numbers; submit results + analysis to the shared Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/clearside-bakeoff).
- Karthik: finalize narrow addendum with Legal (deadline: Dec 13) and prepare the commercial summary for procurement.
- Marissa: be ready to escalate to Sales Leadership by Jan 5 if we don’t get commit; prepare exec one-pager.
- Soojin: coordinate the demo/readout call on Dec 11 and own the follow-up email with the comparison table.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: competitor offers lower headline unit cost by using aggressive quantization; Mitigation: include qualitative notes on fidelity impact from our SEs and offer a short fidelity audit during the readout.
- Risk: procurement asks for extended price guarantees; Mitigation: limit to 3-month price-protection and highlight Dedicated uplift economics.

I’ll draft the readout email after Laura uploads the results. If anything changes escalate immediately.

Thanks,
Soojin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
